Recorded as read; do not silently 'correct' it.

itemized.notes: Ross Romero, Salt Lake County Mayor (Democratic). The PDF is only TWO pages: page 1 cover, page 2 Summary Page. There is NO Schedule A and NO Schedule B - honest non-existence, not a blank schedule and not a zero. LABEL vs FORM: the filename says 'Final_Amended' and index.csv says Year-End; the form checks the January-31 YEAR-END box and separately ticks 'Yes, this is an amendment' with the amendment-of date line left blank. Signed 2/4/13, clerk-stamped FEB 04 2013. THE KEY FINDING: a hand-written note below the Summary Page table reads 'Schedules A + B were unchanged from report filed 1/29/13.' - the filer is incorporating the itemization of the earlier filing by reference. That earlier 1/29/13 report is almost certainly the OTHER Romero filing in this same chunk, key 25bd8dab (Romero_R_12_Final_Mayor_Redacted.pdf, 11 pages), whose Summary Page carries the same Column-A figures (23,055 / 64,174). A human joining these two filings should treat 25bd8dab as the source of Romero's itemized rows and this record as a totals-only amendment; DO NOT double-count them. Summary Page as printed: line 1 Col A 23,055 / Col B 154,067.65; line 2 Col A 64,174.00 / Col B 149,867.82; line 3 44,722.43; line 5 67,777.43; line 6 64,174.00; line 7 3,603.43.
